reviews.review:
I wasn't expecting much after seeing "early access alpha" on store page, but it turned to be quite a fun game.
It's a bit hardcore: you can die in a couple of seconds because of the mistake. Enemy can die fast too. This implies more careful and tactical thinking BUT in a fast-paced environment. Which is very cool, reminded me of good times of Quake 3 - hard at the beginning, but you get hang of it pretty fast and it transforms in a lot of fun packed in a little time.

And of course the many references to Twisted Metal 2 are extremely heartwarming. Even the button codes on loading screen are there, lol. What was an interesting surprise is that there are global events on the map. Like you start at the warehouse, but you figure out that it a big elevator which arrives to the ship deck, expanding the arena, and then after a while this ship crashes into shore, expanding the arena again. Crazy.

Also, the Steam Store page doesn't do the game justice: the last update was 5 months ago, and the previous one was in 2025, which kinda leaves the impression that it almost abandoned. But it's actually not: in Discord, there are monthly and even daily updates on development, which is pretty cool.

Also, I decided to play Twisted Metal through RetroArch again, and now I like Wreckage even more. Controls are more intuitive and fun.

Also, native Linux support is a big plus. One more game for my potato without FPS drops.

Looking forward to more updates :)
